summary: Smoke test of AI Real-Estate Lead Qualifier MVP. Backend: reset, lead creation + dedup by phone, background pipeline (NEW->CALLING->IN_CONVERSATION->HOT), events log, slots, booking (HOT lead), illegal-transition rejection, supervisor, seed, analytics all pass. Frontend: dashboard kanban (7 cols, 17 cards), lead card navigation, capture form, analytics KPIs+funnel chart, compare V1/V2 with Run Supervisor button all render and function correctly.
passed: POST /api/lead creates lead (status NEW) and dedupes by phone (returns same id)
Background pipeline transitions NEW->CALLING->IN_CONVERSATION->HOT within ~12s (Gemini LLM working, qualification json populated, transcript_len=12, score=100)
GET /api/leads/{id}/events returns 9 events including NEW->CALLING, CALLING->IN_CONVERSATION, IN_CONVERSATION->HOT transitions
State-machine guardrail: POST /api/leads/{id}/book on CALLING lead -> 400 'Illegal transition CALLING -> BOOKED'
POST /api/leads/{id}/book on HOT lead -> 200, Appointment created, lead status -> BOOKED
POST /api/leads/{id}/supervisor returns next_action + trace (len 3) + requires_approval flag
GET /api/analytics returns total, booked, qualified, hot, conversion_rate, funnel[7]
Frontend / Kanban dashboard renders with data-testid=kanban-board, 7 kanban-column-* elements, 17 lead-card-* cards
/capture form submits (input-name/phone/email + btn-submit-lead) and creates lead visible in detail page
/analytics shows KPIs (Total Leads=18, Conversion 5.6%, Qualified, Booked) and funnel bar chart
/compare shows V1 rules panel + V2 supervisor panel with lead selectors and 'Run Supervisor' button

failed.issue: Events documents lack a discriminator field 'type' — my parse showed type=None for all 9 events (though from_status/to_status transition events are present alongside untyped rows). Frontend LeadDetail may or may not depend on this.
failed.evidence: curl /api/leads/{id}/events returned rows where e.get('type') is None; some rows also had from_status=None/to_status=None (likely non-transition events like TRANSCRIPT/QUALIFICATION without a 'type' key).

action_items: Optional: standardize event schema with a 'type' field (e.g., TRANSITION/TRANSCRIPT/QUALIFICATION/BOOKING) so consumers can filter — currently only from_status/to_status is populated on transition rows.
notes: All mocked providers (Vapi transcript, Cal.com slots) behaving as scripted. Gemini 3 Flash LLM qualification returned rich JSON (intent/budget/timeline/financing/area/reasoning). No 500s, no overlays, no focus issues observed.
